# EFU Goods Traders

> EFU Goods Traders provides technology infrastructure services (business Wi-Fi, structured cabling, CCTV & surveillance, VoIP & PBX, network security, installation & support) and international trading & supply (construction materials, agricultural products, coconut products, spices/fruits/vegetables, mechanical equipment & components, general sourcing) across Kuwait, the UAE and India.

EFU serves offices, villas, retail, warehouses, education and healthcare environments with end-to-end project delivery: survey, design, supply, installation and ongoing support.

## Technology solutions
- [Business Wi-Fi](https://www.efutraders.com/solutions/business-wifi): Coverage planning, access point installation, mesh and roaming setup for offices, villas and commercial facilities.
- [Structured Cabling](https://www.efutraders.com/solutions/structured-cabling): Cat6, Cat6A and fibre infrastructure with cabinets, patch panels, labelling and testing.
- [CCTV & Surveillance](https://www.efutraders.com/solutions/cctv-surveillance): Wired and IP surveillance, NVR/DVR configuration, remote viewing setup.
- [VoIP & PBX](https://www.efutraders.com/solutions/voip-pbx): IP-PBX systems, IP phone deployment, system migration.
- [Network Security](https://www.efutraders.com/solutions/network-security): Firewall deployment, VPN configuration, network segmentation.
- [Installation & Support](https://www.efutraders.com/solutions/installation-support): On-site installation, troubleshooting, maintenance and upgrades.
- [All solutions](https://www.efutraders.com/solutions)

## Products
[Technology products supplied](https://www.efutraders.com/products): network switches & routers, wireless access points, SFPs & transceivers, fibre & copper products, network cabinets & racks, CCTV cameras & recorders, PBX systems & IP phones, testing tools, microwave & satellite products, IT & office equipment.

## Trading & Supply
[International trading and sourcing](https://www.efutraders.com/trading-supply): civil & construction materials, agricultural products, coconut products, spices/fruits & vegetables, mechanical equipment & components, general sourcing & supply.

## Locations
- [Kuwait](https://www.efutraders.com/) — primary technology and trading operations.
- [UAE](https://www.efutraders.com/locations/ae) — technology infrastructure and project supply.
- [India](https://www.efutraders.com/locations/in) — trading, sourcing and technology products.
